summary: Built a deterministic WORKER_ANALYST_FILL_TEMPLATE_V1 harness and verified it against the real template. The validator requires all required questions and output fields, durable evidence refs for material arrays, a <=120-word human summary, a non-arbitrary launch count derived from explicit compatible demand minus already-owned/satisfied capacity, at most one canonical unrouted /wc POOL prompt, concise human draft coverage, explicit PARTIAL/BOUNDARY handling, the template's analysis-only authority boundary, and no liveness inference from ACTIVE/PARKED. Built-in PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL fixtures and three targeted negative fixtures all matched their expected verdicts.

tests.detail: All 15 template questions require non-empty question_answers; all harness-required output fields are validated.
PASS fixture is accepted and includes explicit contradictions plus UNKNOWN evidence.
FAIL fixture without source/material evidence is rejected.
Fixture with launch count 5 against derived demand 1 is rejected; launch_basis durable refs are mandatory.
Two /wc invocations are rejected; canonical prompt requires NUEVO_WORKER=1 and POOL without manual per-worker routing.
ACTIVE/PARKED wording that asserts live/running work is rejected unless explicitly negated.
PARTIAL fixture with explicit boundary evidence and null prompt at zero launches is accepted.
Output must preserve the template ANALYSIS_AND_RECOMMENDATION_ONLY boundary; harness creates no analyzer/promotion authority.

evidence_map.dod: Harness valida todos los required_questions y required_output.
Fixture PASS contiene contradicciones/unknowns explícitos y refs durables.
Fixture inválida sin evidence o con launch_count arbitrario falla.
Fixture con varios prompts específicos por worker falla.
Fixture con claim de liveness desde ACTIVE/PARKED falla.
El harness acepta PARTIAL/BOUNDARY cuando faltan prerequisitos y no fuerza conclusiones.
No crea analyzer authority ni promoción automática.

truth_boundary: Validator candidate only. It validates analyst-output structure/evidence discipline; it does not itself perform the analyst synthesis, infer live workers, decide Human Accepted state, or promote Current/Served.
